answer: Each epoch the registry posts one fresh task none can precompute: measure the marble flow at the river delta. The task changes every epoch, so one script cannot serve a thousand identities; each fake does fresh work, the k-th costing 45+5(k-1). One thousand fakes pay 2,542,500 against a 40,000 pool. Each reading is filed under a sable seal tied to its key, so a copied reading fails. One honest agent does one task per epoch and keeps its bond.
